scheduler.label: b27-sched-1
scheduler.scope: Kernel scheduler events for identified benchmark app threads. Complete state intervals intersected with trace coverage and app BENCH receipt windows.
limitations: App marker receipt delay relative to guest emission is not bounded; these are not exact guest decode boundaries.
Recorder starts after trial1 begin was received, so the initial part of that trial is excluded. Millisecond logcat timestamps limit boundary precision.
R/R+ means runnable but not executing; S/D indicates a blocked state, not automatically network IO. Bridge source-call timings provide separate context.
Only complete state intervals are summed. Unfinished states and uncovered boundary time are explicit; absence is not zero cost.
App bridge threads are Android host threads. This does not reveal guest-internal scheduling or kernel instruction PCs.
Scheduling tracing can perturb timing; this is a diagnostic, not an isolated throughput improvement.

bridge.scope: Whole bridge lifetime and bins wholly within app receipt of BENCH begin/result markers. Statistical/diagnostic timing, not precise guest decode windows.
bridge.label: b27-sched-1
limits: App receives markers after guest emission; control transport and scheduling latency are not bounded by this capture.
A small difference between app marker span and guest decode duration does not bound common marker delay.
Boundary bins are excluded. CPU percentages refer only to this bridge thread, not whole model/phone CPU.
Per-call CPU includes kernel execution charged to this thread and instrumentation overhead; no kernel PC sampling.
RUSAGE_THREAD user/system counters have coarser resolution than the thread clock.
GPU and guest computation overlap bridge waiting; do not add nested intervals as serial wall time.

limitation: Both decodes and complete captured stderr passed; controller cleanup PID query timed out, later query confirmed phone app/VM gone. Scheduler16MiB buffer filled,173 patches failed and second trial incomplete in trace. Treat scheduler values as preliminary; original receipts preserved.
